text:
[LEXP.9.5.3] Because `t.dwell` reads `monotonic_ns()` ([LEXP.9.5.1]), a
condition reading `t.dwell` is **time-dependent** per [LTIM.2.4.1] and is
re-evaluated and edge-fired under [LTIM.2.4] / [LTIM.2.5].

---

idris.name: ltim_2_4_1__reads_clock
idris.note: A condition reading `t.dwell` is time-dependent: the criterion answers `True` on a `dwell` leaf, so the chain carrying it is re-timed under [LTIM.2.4] and edge-fired under [LTIM.2.5] as the theorems of this module and Rete/NetworkTwoClocks.idr say.
